items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 33:1
items.html: All the discernment of the correction of the five Partzufim of Atzilut, from the side of the Mochin fixed in them, corrected from the Nekudim only their Rosh and Guf, which are but the equivalent of their Ketarim, but from the discernment of the nine lower Sefirot they were not corrected in the permanence of the world of Atzilut. Therefore the pure Kav that was corrected in ZA, in the secret of the three fillings of AB, SAG, MAH, which in Gematria are Kav [102], is discerned as only a single Kav, namely the discernment of the Ketarim as above, and the nine Kabin, namely the nine lower Sefirot of the vessels, are lacking from him. And to this our sages, of blessed memory, alluded: ‘A woman prefers a Kav with intimacy over nine Kabin with abstinence’ (Ketubot 62b; Sotah 20a), which is the discernment of the union of the Nukva with the ZA corrected in Atzilut in the discernment of a single Kav, which is better than the nine Kabin of the Nekudim, which cause abstinence between them, since all the hold of the shells is from them. (Item 25).
